text:
sam-sales: FYI — Borealis Health wants a quick POC. They want Redwood Private in their AWS account. Must-haves: original client IP retained for rate-limiting/logs, SNI passthrough to their ALB, and ability to fail to hosted API within ~2min. They attached a security questionnaire and asked about EIP/NAT costs. What do we need from them?

violet-net: Preserve client IP -> use TGW route/peering or NLB in IP mode targeting ENIs. PrivateLink interface endpoints will show endpoint ENI IPs as source (no original src IP). If they need XFF we can add it but requires TLS termination on our side.

marco-se: For SNI: if we do pure TCP passthrough (no L7 termination) SNI is preserved. If customer requires header injection (X-Forwarded-For), we need certs and KMS plan.

ana-sec: Request: send us completed questionnaire focusing on KMS ownership, VPC Flow Logs retention, and any TLS-inspecting devices in front of traffic. Also require an IAM role spec for the few actions our control plane will perform.

kevin-ops: Minimal runbook + SG snippet below (copy/paste):

Option A (TGW/peering - preserves IP):
- Route spoke -> TGW attachment for service subnets, no NAT.
- SG: allow tcp 443 from spoke CIDRs.
- Temp ops access: allow tcp 15020-15022 from ops CIDR.

Option B (PrivateLink):
- Reserve /28 for interface ENIs. Create interface endpoint in spoke subnets. SG on endpoint: tcp 443 from spoke CIDRs. Note: sources will be ENI IPs.

SG example:
Type: TCP
Port: 443
Source: 10.200.0.0/16
Description: allow app traffic from customer spoke

kevin-ops: Note: if their egress hits a NAT or proxy, client IP will be SNATed.

infra-bot: Created POC ticket RL-4782 assigned @violet-net. Handoff checklist: /28 if PrivateLink OR TGW attachment IDs + route table screenshots. ETA 72 hours.

bryn-ps: Customer asked about failover timing <2m. Is that feasible?

violet-net: Yes if we use Route53 health checks + short TTLs + active/standby endpoints. Well include a test playbook; corporate proxies can extend failover time.

sam-sales: Great. Action items: @marco-se to review questionnaire, @violet-net to produce connectivity doc + test playbook, @kevin-ops finalize SG/NACL snippet, @bryn-ps update pricing notes. Borealis uploaded questionnaire: https://s3.amazonaws.com/borealis/poc/sec-q.pdf. Scheduling SRE sync Wed 9am PT.
